question: What is the VMRS code for line, a/c , cab liquid?
query_1:
MATCH (n)
WHERE n.name =~ '(?i).*liquid.*' OR n.description =~ '(?i).*liquid.*'
RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description, labels(n)[0] as type
LIMIT 20
query_2:
MATCH (n:Component)
WHERE n.name =~ '(?i).*line.*' AND n.code STARTS WITH '001'
RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description
query_3:
MATCH (c:Component {code: '001-001-138'})-[:PART_OF]->(a:Assembly)-[:PART_OF]->(s:System)
RETURN c.code AS component_code, c.name AS component_name, 
       a.code AS assembly_code, a.name AS assembly_name, 
       s.code AS system_code, s.name AS system_name

WHERE n.name =~ '(?i).*cover.*' OR n.description =~ '(?i).*cover.*'
RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description, labels(n)[0] as type
LIMIT 20
query_2:
MATCH (n:Component)
WHERE n.name =~ '(?i).*chrg.*' AND n.code STARTS WITH '048'
RETURN n.code as code, n.name as name, n.description as description
query_3:
MATCH (c:Component {code: '048-001-081'})-[:PART_OF]->(a:Assembly)-[:PART_OF]->(s:System)
RETURN c.code AS component_code, c.name AS component_name, 
       a.code AS assembly_code, a.name AS assembly_name, 
       s.code AS system_code, s.name AS system_name
